newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles mayor orders return of diverted funds.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles mayor orders return of diverted funds.

text.p: Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan has ordered the repayment of nearly $1.1 million of airport revenues diverted to the city's general fund, according to a published report on Friday.

Riordan said in a letter to U.S. Transportation Secretary Rodney Slater that repayment of the $1.1 million should "remove any impediments" to release of federal funds for subway construction, according to the Los Angeles Times.

Federal officials had threatened to withhold subway money if the city continued to tap airport funds. A recent federal audit found that the city had improperly taken airport parking and traffic ticket revenues.
